purpose: Byte-for-byte copies of existing audit records for the engineering report; no experiment was rerun for this archive.

training_provenance: The two transformer reports are from the 2026-10-21 audit. Their wall times are not isolated benchmarks because the small and full-size runs overlapped. Large per-launch artifacts remain in the original local build directories.
